step1_figure.circuit_type: Series-shunt feedback amplifier (configured as a voltage follower)
step1_figure.description: The netlist implements a two-stage amplifier with series-shunt feedback. M1 is a PMOS input device with feedback applied to its source, and M2 is an NMOS common-source second stage. The direct connection from output to M1 source sets the feedback factor beta to 1, creating a voltage follower. This is a complementary, active-load variation of the series-shunt circuit shown in Fig 31.17a.

open_loop_gain_AOL.description: Open-loop gain of the basic amplifier

equation.explanation: Gain from input to output with the feedback loop broken.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends strongly on channel length and bias current.

feedback_factor_beta.description: Feedback factor from output to input

equation.explanation: Fraction of output voltage fed back to the input.

sky130_expected.calculation: Direct connection from output to source of input transistor.

sky130_expected.reasoning: A_OL is large, so A_CL approaches 1/beta = 1.

closed_loop_input_resistance_Rinf.description: Input resistance of the closed-loop amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: Input is connected to MOSFET gate, so R_i is infinite.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gate leakage is the only limit.

closed_loop_output_resistance_Rout.description: Output resistance of the closed-loop amplifier

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on open-loop output resistance and gain.

step3_testbench.description: Measures closed-loop gain, bandwidth, and DC power of the series-shunt feedback amplifier.
